note: Shop items between runs, priced in coins. minCheap = a fresh shop always holds at least this many Meadow Packs, so pricier packs never crowd out cheap bodies. packType picks the odds below. requiresIncome = coins per visit needed before it shows up. requiresBossKills = Frog King wins needed (they carry over through Act resets). bonusNectar = Nectar you start the next run with. weight = how often it shows up in a shop slot. variants: base chance a card is Foil/Holo and the damage bonus each gives. brood: minutes for a comb to hatch a free pack.
